title: Where to Put Testimonials on a Website? 4 Great Places to Feature Reviews

facts.fact: The article states that more than 80 percent of consumers who search online for products, goods, or services are attracted to companies with a high volume of positive consumer reviews from third-party users; the page gives no source for this figure.
facts.quote: more than 80 percent of consumers who search for products, goods, or services online are attracted to companies with a high volume of positive consumer reviews from third-party users.

facts.fact: The article presents four effective places to put testimonials on a website.
facts.quote: here are four effective places to place them.

facts.fact: The article was last updated on September 5, 2023.

The article defines video testimonials as customers providing a video review of a business, which may show a customer talking about their experience or a recorded clip of them using the product or service.
facts.quote: Video testimonials are where customers provide a video review of your business.
